h1: Best sellers and popular items for new visitors
overview: First time visitors have no browsing history, so they need a good first impression. We set simple rules that show best sellers, new arrivals or top rated products to people who have not been here before. We define what best seller means for your store, exclude out of stock items and place the rules on your home page and collection pages. Returning visitors can then move on to other sections without breaking anything.

faq: How do you decide what a best seller is?
We use your recent orders, usually the last 30 or 90 days, and exclude items that are out of stock or low margin if you ask. We show you the rule so it is easy to change.
What counts as a new visitor?
Someone with no earlier visits recognized by your store. We use only on site data and follow your cookie settings, so someone who declines cookies is treated as new.
Can the rules differ by traffic source?
Yes, on Standard and Premium. For example, visitors from a gift guide see gifts first, while visitors from search see best sellers. We need to know the source tags you already use.
